Hello, my name is Scarlet and I'm a BF-holic. Nerd-Girl. Gamer. Early-20's. I love creative games, and I like shooters. Finding one that merged them both was a treat for me. I waited over a month for the Beta to begin, and was lucky enough to get in with a key(grabbed at the last minute!) on the first day. I enjoy the game a lot so far, fun, creativity, and the community overall has been great as well. I sincerely hope we don't lose that when the game goes into Full-Release and that it only gets better. In about two weeks I've already made great friends and look forward to making tons more. ;)

As for myself, I'm a game and internet lover in general. I work online daily, as a Writer, Web Designer, Blogger, Web-Coder and occasional Webcam Broadcaster. If you see me in-game, you wouldn't be able to tell for a second that I do any serious crap like that at all. I'm goofy, I can be stupid, I'll delete the blocks under you just to watch you plummet to your death and laugh maniacally as I do so. I enjoy simple pleasures and just like to have fun and goof off with people in the BF-World.

If you want to chat, shoot, ask questions, build or just hang out feel free to drop me a line or add me in-game. I'm a Staff member of the Lost Clan, so you're welcome to check out the Clan as well. We'd love to have you aboard. I have Teamspeak, Skype and pop onto the game every day, so you're bound to see me around.

Have fun and May the Brick Be with You. <3

Okay, so it seems I never took the time to properly introduce myself. Here I go.

I'll warn you right here : This will be a long post so if you don't like to read, you should probably close this tab or read the previous posts, otherwise you'd hurt yourself. It's not that I like to talk about myself, but I like it when others understand me. On the other hand, if you want to know me better, this thread is for you.

My name is John. I'm Belgian and I'm 21 years old. I started playing on November 27, 2012. I'm here thanks to an IRL friend who told me "hey, I found a new game, it's like minecraft with guns and you can build your maps". He stopped playing after a month but I'm still here because this game's awesome. I've heard it was better before, but I don't really care : I joined the community during the P2W era and I still enjoy it.

I've been playing since I was three. My first game was Duke Nukem 3D. A title that would be rated PEGI 18 today, I think. That's probably why games like slender or amnesia can't frighten me, but more "pixelated" works like minecraft give me the creeps. I also discovered the original X-Com at that age, which is my favorite game along with Arcanum. Then 8 years later I joined multiplayer games like TrackMania, a racing game where I've been successful as a mapper : I made a fan-built sub-genre so popular that the developers themselves liked it and released it as an add-on. I also played a lot of UT99, then UT2004 and Wolfenstein : Enemy Territory, which is in my opinion the best MMOG ever made. It literally has everything one can ask for.

I have two goals in this game. The first being the MotW. I want to be as successful in here as I was in TM, and I know it's possible. My second goal is to reach a 70% K/D the "hard way" : No farming, No action panel, and as few upgrades as possible. Right now, I'm at 67,5% and earn 0,25% per day. Then when I reach this goal, I'll use everything I've saved and stacked so far. I'm doing this because I want to prove myself and the others one can still be competitive without being a P2W slave or a farmer (a +3 Orion is still P2, but not necessarily W). I'm not a guy who likes competition, However I try to be skilled at what I do. Clan Wars are not my type, but if I ever join I clan and they need me, I won't say no.

IRL, I'm unemployed, had to quit school after 4 years of failing exams since I never actually took them, and spend most of my time between my bed and my computer chair. While this sounds like the average idiotic no-life geek, I'm just a physically disabled person. I use a walking stick when I go out, so often that people who don't know me think I'm cosplaying Dr. House. Before my problems started when I was 12, I was a promising sports player who never knew he was going to play so many video games. That's why I like to say I never chose to be a geek. Rather it was the only path available to me at that time. Since I couldn't stay more than 4 hours in school without aching from everywhere, I learnt mostly everything I know, including English, by myself. Video games did educate me more than teachers. So please, If you noticed some typos or grammatical mistakes from my posts, go ahead and tell me what's wrong.
But don't you worry about me, I'm like lady gaga, I was born this way. :P It's genetics, there's nothing to do. I'll have my first job in a few months thanks to my country's disabled people integration agency (even though being disabled brings in cash), and one day I will become a writer. Those who read books will know me as John Blauze. Writing stories is the best thing I do so I'm quite confident, and it could even let me work with game developers if my book's good enough, which is pretty much my dream.

Oh, and for those who are into this kind of details, I'm 5' 1" (1m54) tall, weigh 99 lbs (45 kg) and my blood type is A+. There you go, it's pretty much my whole life in one forum post. I can't make it any smaller. ^^

...What do you mean by "I don't care about your life"? :D

The SCP Foundation (Secure, Contain, Protect) is a website with thousands of user generated stories and creepypastas that are put in the format of a top secret document. These stories are usually codenamed SCP-XXXX, some examples are SCP-087, SCP-173, SCP-1111, etc. The website can be found at this link:

http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/

Each SCP is marked with one of the three classes which includes Safe, Euclid and Keter class.

Safe Class is an SCP that does not show harm and can be kept for later use, without too much to deal with.

Euclid Class are SCP's that are not fully understood, but can be lethal on contact with the SCP. These classes are usually contained to prevent any harm to the foundation's personel.

Keter Classes however, are the most dangerous, they need to be contained carefully and cautiously to prevent injury to any staff. Researchers have also been trying to develope ways in terminating Keter Class SCP's because of how dangerous they are.

My favourite out of the thousands of SCP documents is SCP-387. SCP-387 is a Safe class SCP kept at Site 19. Technically, SCP-387 is a tub of commerical LEGO. SCP-387 can duplicate and animate itself to life, meaning that if you put together a LEGO figure, it will animate to life along with anything else built around. You can read more about SCP-387 at this link:

http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-387

title: What is your ideal Japanese name?

posts.h:
A Japanese name is made of three or four (possibly two but not sure) kanji characters. They look like chinese characters because they basically are chinese characters used in the Japanese language.

Unlike English names, your lastname will be at the front. Mori (森) is a common Japanese lastname.

The rule for your Japanese name is that you cannot write your actual name in Japanese. Think of your favourite manga/anime character's firstname to go with instead. As for the lastname, you can look up on Google to see if it can work as a lastname. In other words, imagine what your name would be if you were to be Japanese.

I'll start off. I have already thought of a Japanese version of my name.

水巻ルカ (Mizumaki Ruka)

One of the characters that I know of just happens to be Urushibara Ruka, so I took the firstname off of that.

As for the lastname, I tried to do 水色 (Mizuiro) which literally means "aqua-colour" or "aqua-blue" but when I looked it up it didn't seem suitable as a Japanese lastname. I somehow found a list of Japanese lastnames and I chose the closest one to Mizuiro instead, which just happens to be 水巻(Mizumaki).

My ideal Japanese name would be スヴィ

Katakana for Suvi. :D

"wa-ta-shi-wa (the original character is "ha" but in this case you pronounce it as "wa")-to-ru-ko-ji-n-de-s"

This literally means, "I am Turkish."

私（わたし）(wa-ta-shi) means "me" or "I."
は (ha, but pronounced "wa") completes "I am ____."
トルコ (toruko) means "Turkey" in Japanese.
人 (jin) literally means "person." By saying "Turkey person" it magically turns into "Turkish."
- Note: The language Turkish is トルコ語 (to-ru-ko-go).
です (desu) completes the sentence by adding politeness. Polite Japanese is a must for foreigners.
- Note: There are some other polite sentence enders depending on your sentence.

- Note: According to what I've heard, でわありません (de-wa-a-ri-ma-se-n) is used for saying "I am not ___." Don't quote me on it, though.

title: [LF HELP] I need some help with Unity3D!!!

posts.h:
I'm looking for some help with Unity3D because I'm trying to create a game and I'm kind of lost. The ideal game is a combination of my drawings (characters), Battlefield (gameplay), Team Fortress 2 (variety in classes), and Black Ops 2 (something similar to CoDcast), but with unique game types and with paintballs instead of bullets.

I'm looking for those who can turn my drawings into 3D models because they are going to be characters (and guns).

I'm also looking for those who can teach me how to make the kind of game I'm looking for. I managed to get the basic movement down, but what about ADS? What about sprinting? What about making that multiplayer? What about different classes?

I'm also looking for those who are willing to set up servers for the game (please don't charge me money for it, I'm broke TT_TT).

I have not set a precise name for it yet, but the game will be a nonprofit game. This is because I've had it with all this pay-to-win crap and figured I should make a game on my own instead. Plus, if I do make too much money I will be forced to upgrade to Unity Pro, and I cannot afford that. The way I would earn money is either through tourneys and other things that would not upset the balance of the game, or just something else outside the game.

Please contact x17_S17MON on skype for details.

Hello, fellow builders/fraggers!

The nickname is Am I Evil, and despite how flattered I was to be considered British, I'm 100% French, born and raised. That's probably why I was hired by Infernum to take care of all the aspects of the French-speaking market.

As far as my background is concerned, I think the only thing relevant for that presentation is that I used to play Quake 2 and Unreal Tournament competitively, back in the days, and that I've been playing video games for more than 20 years now... Times flies.

Thanks a lot again for the warm welcome, I hope I'll be able to help out your French-speaking colleagues!

Cheerios.

Hey, someone might know Waframe, a nice shooter from digital extremes. I have wrote an translated my first fan story, I would really appriciate (or however its written) a feedback! Enjoy!

https://forums.warframe.com/index.ph...story-eng-ger/

Or read it here:

Episode 1 – Assault on the void

“They are too much!” What do we do now? Nyx. She was quite aggressive, but can´t mess with two dozen of Grineer-units. “We need a new cover! Rhino, get the shield!” Another fimiliar voice. Loki. He was the oldest and experienced of all, but was seriously injured. Everywhere burns, some still glow. A napalm-unit got him, everyhere is covered with gas. “Go!” “Stay here – I´ll go forward” I slowly walked toward the grineer with my iron skin, braving the bullets of their Grakatas and Hinds. When I was close enough, I slammed my heavy Warframe against a shieldwielder, and broke his neck to get the shield. Quickly I covered myself with the shield and returned to the others. “On 3 we will go” said Loki, “1…2…3…! Now!” We rushed forwards together. Everything seems to happen in slowmotion. The battle shouting of Loki, our steps, the noise of shells falling on the ground. “We almost made-” Suddenly a loud bang echoed through the void. It interuppted the slow motion. A fragment-grenade exploded directly before Nyx. She was covered with rusty fragments, the blood runs down everywhere of her body. “Fuck, go help her!” “Get her and run!” He didn´t moved. “Run godamnit!” He took her away und I moved slowly due to defend the arriving Grineer behind me. They now should ne at the extraction point. The lets go. But when I arrived, I totally freezed: Nyx and Loki where unconscious lieing at the floor. I turned around, hearing the sound of a ballistas Vulkar. They were behind me. I felt every single bullet shredding trough my body, but felt no pain. I was just full of rage. I just stood there, with finger at the trigger, killing dozens of grineer, until I got no more ammunition…The situation was hopeless. I could just wait untl they came here to kill them with my Ether Reaper. I couldn´t find Nyx´ or Lokis Boltos. Suddenly the basilica crashed – I used the moment to rush forward, the Reaper ready to kill. The first Grineer tried to stand up but I crushed his rips. The others shooted on me, but my armor resisted their bullets. They saw how I executed one and the other and run away panickly. Finally rescue was there, so I put them in the capsule and I clinked myself in. During the flight I asked myself why the basilica crashed. A chruch won´t break in. Even when it´s thousands of years old. I mean I were in the void. And what happened to Nyx and Loki?

Greetings, FlocKster

Hey guys

I'm extremely depressed recently because of a bully who is bullying me for the last... well my whole life since I joined this school. I really don't know what to do and even tried telling the teacher, but they made little attempt to understand. So I decide to ask you guys instead because this issue is kind of linked to Brick-Force. I really don't know how to explain, so instead I'll give you a brief introduction about my class. That way, you can understand a bit.

I hate school, not because of the education, but because of my classmates. Ever since last year in term 1, everyone in my class hates me because of my babyish attitude regardless of my age (13). The cause of this is my bully manage to persuade everyone in the class that I am a bad person and now everyone is against me. Now regardless if I do little things or major things in school, people will start to spread news that I'm an idiot and stuff like that. The whole school is against me.

My bully, is not any type of bully you might consider. He has a really smart brain used for bullying purposes, have a way to persuade people and made them feel bad in order to gain something from them. He's a person with a great strength and ability and can hide from teacher from doing bad things in a matter of seconds. Now, he's like the leader of the school, everyone would listen to him. If he wants someone to get punished, he would exaturate it, and the result would be them getting bullied. As a matter of fact, everyone hates him, but everyone is pretending to be his friend because they're too scared to get bullied by him.

Now you know how my damn school act likes. I'd like to start telling you my problem. It started yesterday and I was talking to someone in Skype and told them "I'm a 2 year member of Brick-Force and in my opinion, it's the best social-fps mix game I've ever played" I even changed my Skype status to "nothing matters now, Brick-Force is life, Brick-Force is love". He asked me how many hours I played, I told him 66 and that last year I played it through the non-steam version as well. This send him laughing.

The next day, my friend toled Nam Anh (our bully) about our conversation, he then starts to spread the word to everyone and when I came in class. He gave me a piss-off face and told me "yeah David, your stupid game Brick Force is all you care like you F^*(ing do" that got me depressed and in school time, everyone starts to tease me. I found a friend to talk and then I overheard someone saying that I manage to find someone to talk so I won't feel sad, they called me a loser after that and a loner. And in the middle of school, he would regularly pass by and say "why aren't you at home playing Brick-Force moron?" and when I argued telling him what he is trying to persuade me he tolled me this:

"I'm trying to tell you that you're a lier, and that you'v never played 2 years before. Oh, and stop showing off, cause nobody gives a shi& about what you do. STFU, you're not part of this"

I cried, but hid it behind me too scared to show him my face. He's not any bully you expect to be, he's a different one and he doesn't classify that he actually is one. Please, give me a solution to this issue.

I am not sure of the laws of Vietnam, but in Canada if you file a report to the police you could charge that person with harassment. If your place of living has a charter of rights and freedoms, or a document explaining laws more clearly try looking to find a section about harassment and if you can find that report it to the police and try to get some help.

In my past I have been bullied numerous amounts of times. In my school it was mainly ignore the insults so the bully thinks I do not care, then they'll move on to something else, rinse and repeat until the bully has inevitably given up on trying to make you feel miserable since they just can't.

In your case I would try to do as I recommended by trying to find some legal information about it, or if the situation is good enough just ignore the bully (The one you're describing sounding more of a mental type of bully and not as much of a physical type of bully, so I wouldn't think they'd be able to beat you up.) Figure out the patterns of the bully. What he does and see if there's a pattern and manipulate it so it is in your favor. Find a group of people that you have common interests with and can at least somewhat talk with then build a bond from there. Talk to your school principal, or head master and try to talk with them too. Explain the situation very clearly and you could possibly settle with an outcome.

Or the easiest outcome: Move away.
Good luck!

Kind Regards,
-boopboopMC
The Brick-Force Community Team

Yes, he is a mental type of bully at a very high standard at both smart and bad ways. But he is also very physical too, he just doesn't use it if necessary. I found a pattern to my bully but no solution at all to the pattern. That bstard knows how to talk, and the only way to beat him in a an argument is by knowing how to talk too. You see, he uses some element of truth about us and then combine it with our argument in order for us to feel bad about it. I have no one smart to talk to about my feelings, I think the only way to express it out is by this forum. I've tried talking to the headmaster a several time but I don't know how to describe his actions, so that made it hard. But thank you for the advice anyways.

If you didn't know what I am talking about his pattern. Here is an example:
Him: "Hey David, I know your secert"

Him: "That you're a gay"
Me: "No I'm not"
Him: "Yeah right, then why were you so desperately trying to sit next to Alex (a friend name) so desperately when we came into class eh?"
Me: "That's because there was no space and I didn't want to sit next to a table filled with girls"

Another thing I do a lot to get rid of bullies is either A: Be nice to them, or B: joke around. Play with their insults. If they know you think it is funny, it won't be as fun for them anymore, and they'll move onto the next insult. I've thrown in more information that could be used against me on occasion, but eventually I got out of it.

In my life I've had over 20 bullies, ranging from the punch now ask questions later type of bully to the smart type who tries to merely manipulate you into thinking you're a horrible person. That's why I laugh now when I hear an insult; because I turned them all into jokes.

"Calling me gay? Surely you can come up with something at least a bit more creative. I've been called many things in my time and gay is only one name from the tip of the iceberg."
